registered.title: No float value on `source.buffer.v1`: record fields, conversions, value statements and loop bodies, and the composed string route
registered.why: Found by W48-QR-FLOATING-POINT (item 2 of its brief, not reached). The byte-buffer route keeps refusing every float spelling: a `type R { x: f64 }` field there (its record reader stays on the integer table), `let y = x as f64;` (its conversion reader), a float literal or `partial_eq`/`partial_ord` in its value statements (its reader runs without floats, and a float operand that reached it is refused by name, `Q051`), and so every loop body and the composed string/buffer route that embeds its readers. Widening it means the typed environment (`BufferEvaluation::typed`) holding bit patterns, float literals at field values and operands read once at their type, the entry row's comparison effects feeding the shared decision, the emitter's float members, conversions (exact thresholds), renderers and IEEE environment, and the byte views staying on `i32`/byte positions only; a float loop bound stays refused. Size M. DISCHARGE: the route admitting the float rules at every scalar position it has, the §G02t boundary table run natively through it, and the fixture freeze byte-identical for every integer program.

A float payload needs its byte extent (4/8), typed payload events carrying bit patterns with every NaN one event (a NaN's payload is not specified, so a byte read of a NaN payload has no reference value the native run must equal: either canonicalise at the write or refuse byte reads of a float payload), the F02 alphabet's typed payload refusal kept, and the mutex route's fill. Size M. DISCHARGE: float payloads on the task and mutex routes with their byte views decided, native runs equal to the reference, and the payload Lean theorems re-decided over float sizes.

registered.title: The float emission is built natively with Clang on Linux only
registered.why: Found by W48-QR-FLOATING-POINT. The emitted float C — the `_Static_assert`s on `<float.h>` and `FLT_EVAL_METHOD`, the `#pragma STDC FP_CONTRACT OFF` guarded to Clang, the compound-literal renderer buffers `(char[48]){0}`, the union compound literal spelling a NaN or an infinity, the hexadecimal float constants — is built and run here with Clang 21 on x86-64 Linux only. MSVC (`/fp:strict`, its C11 mode's compound literals) and Apple Clang on arm64 (where contraction is FMA by default and the build premise `-ffp-contract=off` matters most) are unmeasured. Size S. DISCHARGE: the card's native boundary table, renderer sample and extern/FFI/task rows built and run on Windows/MSVC and macOS/arm64, each platform against its own reference.
